caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl with a wide rim, viewed from above, rendered in shades of grey using pencil. Attached to the upper side of the bowl is an integrated, rounded tab with a single small hole near the top, also shaded in grey. The bowl is composed of concentric circles, suggesting a stepped or layered internal profile. The drawing is bordered by a fine rectangular outline. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller, inset side view of the same object, showing its profile and indicating the presence of the rim and the projecting tab. The background is a plain off-white or beige paper. The artist's signature, "R. E. DENBERG," appears in the lower right corner of the main bounding box.
title: Pewter Porringer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
